sources.title: Nemotron 3 Nano 4B: A Compact Hybrid Model for Efficient Local AI
sources.snippet: Together, these capabilities demonstrate the model’s strong suitability for edge use cases. Nemotron 3 Nano 4B was pruned and distilled from Nemotron Nano 9B v2 using the Nemotron Elastic framework, allowing it to inherit the strong reasoning capabilities as a hybrid reasoning model.
